test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate title for the given passage.
solution:
The correct answer is Earth and its Dangers.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses various dangers that Earth is facing, such as deforestation, wildlife decline, land degradation, ocean acidification, plastic and chemical pollution, and rising CO2 emissions.
 
• These points indicate that the passage is primarily concerned with the threats and challenges to Earth's environment.
 
• Therefore, "**Earth and its Dangers**" is the most suitable title for the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Earth and Nature** - This title is too broad and does not focus specifically on the dangers discussed in the passage.
 
• **Nature and Animals** - This title narrows down the scope and misses the focus on environmental threats.
 
• **Animals and Birds** - This title is too specific and does not cover the broader environmental issues presented.
